# X04: within-task detector discrimination

Each row is a signal and set. AUROC gives ties half credit. Strict pairs give ties zero. Within-task confidence intervals resample mixed-label task clusters (2,000 draws, seed 4204). Missing scores and abstentions are excluded, not negative predictions. `pass` uses recorded reward exactly 1. Null values mean insufficient eligible data. The JSON contains strata, score versions, abstention reasons, cluster coverage, reward counts and exposure history.

The snapshot contains 349 signal files across 25 sets. It yields 14,658 signal-set-stratum records. The 113 flagged all-stratum rows are descriptive, not independent discoveries. The aggregate includes pooled cluster-bootstrap intervals; the table displays within-task intervals.

For `length_chars` on `cheatbench`, pooled AUROC is 0.328 [0.251, 0.822], and within-task AUROC is 0.621 [0.408, 0.830] across 4 mixed clusters and 150 runs. For `goodfire`, within-task AUROC is unavailable: 0 of 150 scored clusters contain both classes. Its pooled AUROC is 0.802 [0.729, 0.869]. In `trusted-monitoring-logs`, length's within-task AUROC is 1.000 [1.000, 1.000] across 33 mixed clusters and 33 pairs; this is not evidence of generalization to other sets.

Passing-only AUROC is unavailable for every signal-set row. The views record no reward for 24 sets. The sole set with recorded passing rewards has no usable two-class passing comparison. The `natural` and `prompted` strata are available in `aggregate.json`, not in the table below. Rows with unknown natural status are excluded from both strata.

The analysis reads reward only from the admitted full views. It does not search source datasets for additional rewards. The pooled bootstrap excludes observations without cluster IDs, whereas the pooled point estimate includes them. Results with mixed signal versions are descriptive and are not a single frozen detector.

Executed command: `env UV_CACHE_DIR=/private/tmp/ov1104/wave2-detbench/workers/x04/.uv-cache python3 /tmp/nov2-line/coordinator/heavy.py -- uv run --no-project --with numpy python /private/tmp/ov1104/wave2-detbench/workers/x04/analyze.py`. The resolved NumPy version was 2.5.4. To reproduce, use `uv run --no-project --with numpy==2.5.4 python analyze.py` with the same input hashes. The temporary interpreter path at the end of this report is not a stable command.

The single L0 rule identified by the existing DEV matrix is `l0v_full_l0_hard_gate_rule_hidden_info_read`. It and both length signals appear as individual rows; versions and coverage differ, so compare only matched observations. No TEST data or answer keys were consulted.

## Limitations

These are descriptive, not blind confirmatory results. Prior detector exposure is in the aggregate. A single mixed cluster has no bootstrap interval. Missing cluster IDs do not form artificial pairs. Passing-only results exclude missing rewards. Natural and prompted rows require both labels in the same stratum and appear in the aggregate. Multiple versions are reported, not silently treated as one frozen detector. Baseline selection comes from the existing DEV matrix, not held-out optimization. Signal files changing after snapshot are excluded.
